ok.description: Always `true`; failure becomes an HTTP error.

401.description: No token, expired token, or invalid signature.

404.description: Project, session, or handoff not found.

409.description: The Criativo is still in the middle of a turn — the confirmation was recorded but the brief did not start (ADR 0163).

422.description: No business rule was captured in this conversation — there is nothing to consolidate into a brief yet (ADR 0163).

429.description: Rate limit per user or per IP.
